title: Use an Agent-first venue-aware writing brief
description: Adds a lightweight, source-backed venue writing brief only for paper deliverables and removes the conflicting generic article fallback.
changes: Create planning/venue-writing-brief.md from official requirements and nearby venue papers when a paper is requested.
Separate the source paper venue from the intended submission venue.
Keep missing template requirements unknown instead of guessing.
Leave failed template exports as drafts instead of falling back to generic article.

rollback.notes: Restore the prior main prompt snapshot.
